headline: Singapore GP Sunday: Verstappen and Russell lead grid into 62-lap night race
whyCareReason: Verstappen starts on pole alongside Russell as championship leader Antonelli fights from fourth to protect his title advantage.
teaser: Lights out under the Marina Bay floodlights at 20:00 local time (12:00 UTC). 62 laps of grueling physical endurance.
story: The 2026 Singapore Grand Prix ignites under the floodlights of the Marina Bay Street Circuit on Sunday evening. After sweeping Saturday's Sprint victory and claiming pole position in qualifying with a lap of 1:29.525, Max Verstappen commands the front of the grid. George Russell shares the front row for Mercedes (+0.145s), hungry to convert his pace into a grand prix triumph. For championship leader Kimi Antonelli, Sunday represents a defining crucible: starting fourth behind Charles Leclerc, the Italian rookie must master Marina Bay's grueling 62 laps of humidity and concrete barriers to preserve his 81-point championship buffer over Russell.
stakes: A Russell victory cuts deeply into Antonelli's points lead, while Verstappen seeks back-to-back weekend perfection in Singapore.
rivalryAngle: Verstappen, Russell, Leclerc, and Antonelli fight wheel-to-wheel down the drag to Turn 1.
funFacts: Marina Bay is the only Grand Prix on the calendar where the Safety Car has appeared in every single edition.
Drivers can lose up to three kilograms of body weight during the grueling two-hour race.
Verstappen swept both Sprint victory and GP pole on Saturday in Singapore.

keyPlayers.hook: Starts on the front row looking to claim crucial points in the title fight.
